## About
Apex Electrical Contracting LLC. works out of Hwy 34 in Matawan and serves all of New Jersey. We're a commercial and industrial specialist, and we wire homes too: switchgear, generators, lighting upgrades and solar power, plus repairs on the systems you already have.
The wiring of your company or home is important for your safety and comfort. Our licensed electricians keep you well informed at every stage of the project and stand behind their work, before and after the job.
Neighbors know Dean by name. We're rated 5 on Google from 62 reviews, and reviewers talk about honest pricing, quick responses and a crew that checks in on them.

## Services
- Emergency Electrical Repairs: Lost power, a knocked down line or something that just isn't right. Call and we'll come out.
- New Construction and Renovation: Electrical work for new builds and renovations, homes and commercial spaces alike.
- Maintenance and repair of existing electrical systems: Preventative maintenance is one of the best ways to save money on your electrical needs.
- Modernization of electrical installations in old structures: Bringing older buildings and homes up to date.
- Cable Bus Systems: Systems that can close doors and windows, set the alarm and regulate heating, ventilation and lighting automatically. We'll advise you on planning and implementation.
- Electric Charger stations: Charger station installation for homes and businesses.
- Parking lot lighting: Lighting for lots and commercial properties, along with sign repairs.
- Air conditioning troubleshooting: We track down the electrical side of air conditioning problems.

## FAQ
Q: When can I reach you?
A: Our office hours are listed as 24/7, and Google shows us Open 24 hours every day of the week.

Q: Do you work on homes or just businesses?
A: Both. We do electrical installations for private, commercial and industrial clients, plus retail and medical work.

Q: What areas do you cover?
A: We're based in Matawan and serve all of New Jersey, including Middlesex, Monmouth, Somerset, Bergen, Hudson, Ocean and Mercer counties.

Q: Will you explain what you're doing?
A: Yes. We'll walk you through the work in easy-to-understand terms and answer any concern you have.
